id: 52_What are the main risks of hazardous materials for humans and the environment tr
title: 危险物品对人和环境的主要风险
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/52_What are the main risks of hazardous materials for humans and the environment tr.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/52_What are the main risks of hazardous materials for humans and the environment tr/src.py

points.K10: 对环境：破坏生态，物种减少
points.K11: 统一的分类和标签制度
points.K14: 随货附上安全技术说明书
points.K15: 培训合格的人来操作和应急

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一半是实验室、一半是河流草地的背景前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a background that is half laboratory and half river and meadow, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 危险物品伤的不只是人。
overlay: 危险物品伤人也伤环境

shots.scene: 一个天平，一边是人形图标，一边是地球图标
shots.prompt_en: A balance with a human figure icon on one side and a globe icon on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 今天看看，它对人和环境的危害。

shots.scene: 阿杰洗完器皿，准备把一烧杯废液倒进水池
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finishes washing glassware and is about to pour a beaker of waste liquid into the sink.
shots.narration: 阿杰想把一点废液倒进水池。

shots.scene: 阿杰说话的样子，旁边一个“就一点点”的小手势
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shrugs and pinches his fingers to show a tiny amount.
shots.narration: 他说：就一点点，又没碰到手。

shots.scene: 小研拦住阿杰，把烧杯拿开
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the young male student and takes the beaker away.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：一点点，也会伤人伤环境。

shots.scene: 两条箭头从一个危险品瓶分别指向人形和河流
shots.prompt_en: Two arrows lead from a hazardous material bottle to a human figure and to a river. No people.
shots.narration: 危险物品，对人和环境都有风险。

shots.scene: 手臂图标上出现红色烫伤痕迹，旁边火焰和腐蚀象形图
shots.prompt_en: A forearm icon with a red burn mark, next to flame and corrosion pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 对人，首先是烧伤。

shots.scene: 骷髅象形图，人形图标脸色发青
shots.prompt_en: The skull pictogram beside a human figure icon looking ill and pale. No people.
shots.narration: 第二是中毒。

shots.scene: 鼻子、嘴巴、皮肤三个入口图标
shots.prompt_en: Three entry route icons: a nose, a mouth, and skin on a hand. No people.
shots.narration: 毒物经呼吸、嘴巴和皮肤进入身体。

shots.scene: 肺部图标里飘进灰色雾气
shots.prompt_en: Grey fumes drift into a lung icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第三是伤呼吸道和肺。

shots.scene: 细胞图标慢慢变色，旁边日历翻过很多页
shots.prompt_en: A cell icon slowly changes color as calendar pages flip by. No people.
shots.narration: 第四是致癌等长期危害。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓上，内部器官图标闪着淡淡的警示色
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with internal organ icons glowing in a faint warning color. No people.
shots.narration: 伤害可能多年后才显现。

shots.scene: 生物危害标志，微生物图标飘向人形
shots.prompt_en: The biohazard warning sign, with microbe icons drifting toward a human figure. No people.
shots.narration: 第五是感染。

shots.scene: 心电图线由起伏变成一条直线的图标，红色警示
shots.prompt_en: A heartbeat line icon that flattens into a straight line, with a red alert. No people.
shots.narration: 最严重时，会危及生命。

shots.scene: 水池下水管通向河流，河水变色
shots.prompt_en: A sink drain pipe leads to a river, and the river water changes color. No people.
shots.narration: 对环境：污染水体。

shots.scene: 地面渗下的液滴把土壤染色，植物枯黄
shots.prompt_en: Drops seeping into the ground stain the soil and plants turn yellow. No people.
shots.narration: 渗进土壤，也很难清除。

shots.scene: 小鱼吃了小点，大鱼吃了小鱼，小点越来越多
shots.prompt_en: A small fish eats tiny dots, a bigger fish eats the small fish, and the dots pile up inside it. No people.
shots.narration: 有些毒素，会在生物体内蓄积。

shots.scene: 食物链最上方是一个人形，体内的小点最多
shots.prompt_en: At the top of the food chain stands a human figure icon holding the most dots. No people.
shots.narration: 顺着食物链，最后回到人身上。

shots.section_title: 对环境：破坏生态，物种减少
shots.scene: 一片湿地由绿变灰，水鸟飞走
shots.prompt_en: A wetland fades from green to grey as water birds fly away. No people.
shots.narration: 生态系统会被破坏。
overlay: 对环境：破坏生态，物种减少

shots.section_title: 对环境：破坏生态，物种减少
shots.scene: 一排动植物图标逐个变淡消失
shots.prompt_en: A row of plant and animal icons fades out one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 物种减少，生物多样性下降。

shots.section_title: 统一的分类和标签制度
shots.scene: 地球图标和一本空白标准书，箭头相连
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon connected by an arrow to a blank standard booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 怎样安全运输和标识？有统一规则。
overlay: 统一的分类和标签制度

shots.section_title: 统一的分类和标签制度
shots.scene: 标准书封面上一个红框菱形，旁边一本外文规章书
shots.prompt_en: A blank standard booklet with a red diamond pictogram on the cover next to a blank regulations book. No people.
shots.narration: 遵循GHS和美国职安署的危害告知标准。

shots.scene: 货箱上贴着彩色菱形运输标志
shots.prompt_en: A shipping crate with colored dangerous goods labels. No people.
shots.narration: 货包贴联合国危险类别菱形标志。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员看到货箱标志，示意绕行
shots.prompt_en: The security officer sees the labels on the crate and gestures others to keep clear.
shots.narration: 一眼就知道里面是哪类危险。

shots.scene: 瓶子装进内层密封袋、吸附垫，再放进坚固外箱
shots.prompt_en: A bottle is sealed in an inner bag with absorbent padding and placed into a sturdy outer box. No people.
shots.narration: 包装要合规，封装要可靠。

shots.section_title: 随货附上安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 货箱上插着一份空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: A blank safety data sheet is attached to the crate. No people.
shots.narration: 随货附上安全技术说明书。
overlay: 随货附上安全技术说明书

shots.section_title: 培训合格的人来操作和应急
shots.scene: 王老师培训，小研和阿杰听课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads a training session; the female graduate student and the young male student listen.
shots.narration: 操作和搬运，要由培训合格的人来做。
overlay: 培训合格的人来操作和应急

shots.section_title: 培训合格的人来操作和应急
shots.scene: 老李拿着溢洒处置箱演示，阿杰跟着做
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer demonstrates with a spill kit while the young male student practices.
shots.narration: 出了状况，懂得怎么应急。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，左边人形图标周围亮起几个小图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard; small icons light up around a human figure on the left.
shots.narration: 对人：烧伤、中毒、伤肺、致癌、感染。

shots.scene: 右边地球图标周围亮起几个小图标
shots.prompt_en: Small icons light up around a globe on the right.
shots.narration: 对环境：污染、蓄积、破坏生态。

shots.scene: 标志、包装、说明书、培训四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a diamond label, a package, a document, a trainer.
shots.narration: 标志、包装、说明书、培训，缺一不可。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在清澈的河边，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a clear river and waves goodbye to the camera.
shots.narration: 护好自己，也护好环境，再见！
